title: Pakistani Chicken Karahi
description: Top this spicy chicken karahi dish with fresh cilantro and serve with hot naan bread and lentils for a simple and authentic Pakistani meal.
ingredients: 1 (3 pound) whole chicken, giblets discarded, cut into 12 pieces
4 green chile peppers, finely chopped, or more to taste
1 bunch fresh cilantro leaves, finely chopped

steps.text: Heat oil in a large pot or karahi over high heat. Add chicken pieces and cook until starting to brown, about 5 minutes. Add water, cumin, salt, ginger and garlic paste, red chile powder, and turmeric; cook and stir until fragrant, about 30 seconds.

Stir tomatoes and green chile peppers into the pot. Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook until chicken pieces are no longer pink at the bone, about 30 minutes. An instant-read thermometer inserted near the bone should read 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).
Sprinkle cilantro leaves over chicken and cook until leaves look slightly wilted, about 30 seconds.
